description: "The Complete Poetical Works of James Russell Lowell" by James Russell Lowell is a collection of the author's poems compiled during the late 19th century. The anthology showcases a rich tapestry of themes ranging from love and nature to social commentary and personal reflection, capturing the essence of Lowell's lyrical prowess and his engagement with contemporary issues of his time.
